findings.current: 结束本会话、按名称/pid指定会话或全部；/resume可重开
findings.english: End this session, another by name/pid, or all — /resume reopens it
findings.problem: The scoping word 'another' (a session OTHER than this one) is not rendered: 按名称/pid指定会话 reads as 'the session designated by name/pid', which can include this one. Behaviour is unaffected — naming or pid-ing a session is unambiguous, ending this one twice is harmless, and the destructive third arm ('or all', 或全部) is intact — so this is a nuance loss, not a misdirection. Reported because the line sits exactly at the 51-cell column limit and the omission is therefore a forced trade rather than an oversight a reader should assume away.
findings.suggestion: No in-budget fix exists. Measured alternatives: '结束本会话、按名称/pid结束其他会话或全部；/resume可重开' = 55 cells; '结束本会话、其他会话(按名称/pid)或全部；/resume可重开' and '结束本会话、按名称/pid的其他会话或全部；/resume可重开' = 53 cells each — every form that carries 'another' exceeds the 51-cell offer-view column by 2-4 cells, and each buys them by lengthening the tail the picker would then clip. Recommendation: accept as-is at this budget, or raise the description column width product-wide; do not truncate.
findings.note: The clause shape is inherited from 7159e2a309^ (…按名称/pid指定的会话…); the commit recompressed it to fit 51 cells without changing what it scopes. Not a defect introduced by this remediation.

method.mechanical: Both files parsed as JSON; 52/52 keys, identical order, no added/dropped key; zero ICU arguments and zero {placeholders} in the namespace; scenario token scan (--flags, /commands, <args>, 'words', uppercase acronyms) found no dropped flag, path, command or placeholder — the only scan hits are hyphenated compounds (-consumption, -schema, -link, -push) and acronyms or subverbs fused to neighbouring CJK (MCP服务器, OAuth授权, add/remove增删, UI语言), which is the fused-Latin convention and not token loss; no value identical to English; no leading/trailing or double spaces; LF endings, trailing newline present; ASCII punctuation confined to Latin fragments and to the file's consistent subverb lists.
method.semantics: Every one of the 52 values read against its English source for dropped verbs, added claims, negation and scoping. Command behaviour checked where a rendering depends on it: /highlights subverbs adjustable (cancel|retry|adjust), /aida opens her session or sends her a request (_cmd_aida → _aida_open), /stop and /delete arms, /credential masked capture.
method.terminology: Cross-catalogue check on the bytes, not from the predecessor's summary: 亮点, 订阅, 自动push, schema, 凭据, 工作流 (workstream, matching cli.exec_help.workstream), mesh kept Latin, 幕僚长 (chief of staff, matching wire.settings.aida*), 负责人 (matching tui.projects.form.owner_placeholder; 经理 never occurs), 会话/智能体/提示词/审批/用量/费用/压缩 per the style guide's locale calls.
method.style_guide: i18n/style-guides/zh-CN.md read and applied: no space between CJK and Latin runs, full-width marks for prose, Latin punctuation only inside Latin/code fragments, no sentence-final 。 on labels, 你-form, no 您/你 repetition, Latin 'token' for LLM tokens.
method.width: Cells counted as 2 for East Asian Wide/Fullwidth and 1 for ASCII, the accounting zh-CN.md itself prescribes and the same one the commit cites. Result: no zh value exceeds its English counterpart; max zh 51 cells vs max en 74; values over 51: none; at exactly 51: fork, stop (no headroom); next 50 agent, 49 project. Picker geometry verified in code rather than inherited: descriptions are clipped by truncate_cells with a dynamic column (command_picker.py:2455-2463), so an over-budget value loses its tail — which is why 'at budget' is reported as no headroom, not as comfortable.
